title: Maintenance Engineering Specialist (Relocation to Saudi Arabia is required)
descriptionHtml:
This position requires full relocation to Saudi Arabia. It is a permanent full time Expat position with an attractive relocation package.


Please note only qualified candidates will be contacted.


Overview:


We are seeking a Maintenance Engineering Specialist to join Maintenance Solution Department (MSD) under Global Manufacturing Excellence.

MSD is responsible for providing specialized and timely maintenance engineering support to Global Manufacturing operating facilities.

The primary role is to provide technical expertise pertaining to the development, launching, and assessment of various maintenance programs, processes, procedures and best practices for Global Manufacturing facilities.


Key Responsibilities:


As the successful candidate you will be required to perform the following:

  • Develop maintenance processes, maintenance management strategy, work and performance management strategy and conduct Maintenance health assessment in line with GME and corporate requirements. This includes PM and PdM strategies, Organization structures, manpower analysis, cost analysis, etc., and appraise and prepare reports on the effectiveness of such processes.
  • Conduct data driven analyses to benchmark maintenance organization’s performance to identify gaps and set sustainable plan to close the gaps. This includes, but not limited to: Spending Analysis, Maintenance Effectiveness, operating costs of existing assets, PM, and PdM, Wrench time analysis, SAP Taxonomy, Planning & Scheduling, Personnel Competency, Budgeting Strategy, Bad Actors, and RAM Modeling.
  • Analyze facilities’ maintenance performance to establish reference baseline & issue frequent maintenance benchmarking reports to promote knowledge.
  • Review maintenance reporting mechanism and KPIs along with their trends to drive performance and provide recommendations accordingly.
  • Analyze maintenance spending in terms of manpower, equipment, materials procurement and outsource strategies.
  • Assist the line maintenance organizations in the implementation of approved programs such as TPRM or GM reliability model.
  • Develop methods and programs for handling new situations in maintenance fields. This will include prototype pumps, motors, compressors, turbines, valves, instrument systems and computer systems.
  • Design, in conjunction with engineering personnel and vendor representatives, alternative parts or systems.
  • Represent AMSD on standing Committees, Special Task Groups or Ad Hoc Committees.
  • Recommend work which can be economically assigned to contractor organizations and develops scope of work.


Minimum Requirements:


  • You will hold a Bachelor degree in Engineering from a recognized and approved program. A Mechanical Engineering Degree is preferred.
  • You will have a minimum of 10 years of relevant experience in the Oil & Gas downstream Sector.
  • You will be able to demonstrate high degree of technical competence in the area of maintenance programs and practices.
  • You will have experience with risk-based processes such as Reliability-Centered Maintenance & Risk Based Maintenance
  • You will have experience with TotalProductive Maintenance
  • You must have strong hands-on experience with Spare Parts and Materials procurement strategies
  • You will have Best-in-class Maintenance Planning, Scheduling and Work Prioritization experience
  • You must have strong Experience with Maintenance budgeting and spending control methodologies.
  • You will have Experience in field maintenance methodologies, processes, and procedures.
  • You will be able to demonstrate experience with CMMS such as SAP

title: Sr. Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Job Description

Qualification : Bachelor’s in Mechanical Engineering

Industry: Power Systems, Power Generation, Off-Highway Engine

Years of Experience: 4 to 5 years

Job Location: Pune

Why Rolls-Royce?

At Rolls-Royce we are proud to be a business that has truly helped to shape the modern world and are committed to always being a force for progress; powering, protecting and connecting people everywhere.

By joining Rolls-Royce, you'll have the opportunity to work on world-class solutions, supported by a culture that believes individuality is our greatest strength, and all perspectives, experiences and backgrounds help us innovate and enable our high-performance culture.

Required Skills

Expertise in design of off-highway engine parts and reverse engineering of complex cast components. Strong command of 3D CAD modeling using Creo, experience with Windchill PLM, and working knowledge of SAP. Deep understanding of casting processes, material selection, and reverse engineering methodologies.

Role Requirements

  • Perform design of complex engine sub systems for off-highway engines.
  • Perform reverse engineering of cast parts using 3D scanning and CAD reconstruction techniques.
  • Create detailed 3D models and 2D manufacturing drawings using Creo.
  • Manage engineering changes and design data using Windchill.
  • Manage part release management in the PLM system.
  • Ensure GD&T applications.
  • Maintain accurate BOMs and component master data in SAP.
  • Conduct DFMEA and participate in design reviews to ensure robust and reliable designs.
  • Interface with suppliers to optimize casting designs for manufacturability.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including sourcing, manufacturing, and quality, to ensure design feasibility and cost-effectiveness.
  • Utilize various standards like ASME , SAE, and ISO.

Key Skills & Tools Knowledge

  • Proficiency in Creo (3D modeling, casting & sheet metal design features)
  • Experience with Windchill for PLM activities
  • Working knowledge of SAP for engineering change and BOM management
  • Strong grasp of reverse engineering fundamentals (3D scanning, surface reconstruction, etc.)
  • Good understanding of casting processes, materials, and GD&T
  • Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills

Power Systems is the Rolls-Royce business which provides world-class power solutions and complete life-cycle support under our product and solution brand mtu. Through digitalisation and electrification, we strive to develop drive and power generation solutions that provide answers to the challenges posed by the rapidly growing societal demands for energy and mobility.

We deliver and service comprehensive, powerful and reliable systems, based on both gas and diesel engines, as well as electrified hybrid systems. These technologically advanced solutions serve our customers in the marine and infrastructure sectors worldwide.

Our vision is to ensure that the excellence and ingenuity that shaped our history continues into our future. Our multi-year transformation programme aims to turn Rolls-Royce into a high-performing, competitive, resilient and growing company. Join us, and it can be your future vision too.

Rolls-Royce are committed to being a respectful, inclusive, and non-discriminatory workplace where individuality is valued, diverse perspectives fuel innovation, and everyone can thrive.

As part of our selection process, candidates in certain locations may be asked to complete an online assessment, which can include cognitive and behavioural aptitude testing relevant to the role. If required, full instructions for the next steps will be provided.

title: Engineer - APC/RTO
descriptionHtml:
Experience And Qualifications

  • Min. BE/B Tech in Chemical Engineering from a reputed institute, specialisation in Controls would be favourable
  • Min. 4-6 years of work experience in CTS / Process Control
  • Should have aptitude and passion for working with Control systems, APCs & RTOs.

Skills Required (Knowledge And Skills)

  • Selected candidates would have in-depth understanding and interest towards learning process technology and plant operations. Sufficient knowledge about equipment design, optimisation, economics, controls, DCS instrumentation, safety interlocks, start-up and shut-down procedures, and other relevant aspects of design, technology and operations.
  • Willingness to study, learn, understand new areas of application and work with panel officers, plant engineers, and technical service staff.
  • Readiness to travel and stay during projects or postings at various sites.
  • Application knowledge of DMCplus, Aspen IQ, ROMeo, PID Tuning, MILANO, Unisim would be favourable.
  • Embrace the company values and behaviours of Ownership mindset and Customer value, Respect and Integrity, One team and Excellence.

Job Purpose

Design, Implement, Maintain, Monitor and Audit multiple Process Control System including, Base level PID control, APCs, RTOs & Blending Systems

Job Accountabilities

  • Tune DCS PIDs, analyse and suggest improvements in the base layer regulatory control system, work along with site Instrument engineers.
  • Design, Implement, and Maintain Advanced Process Control (APC) Systems
  • Configure, Implement, and Maintain Real Time Optimiser (RTO) Systems
  • Configure, Implement, and Maintain Refinery Feed & Product Blending Systems
  • Design, Configure and maintain Soft sensors for use in APCs and RTOs
  • Sustain control system objectives Ensure Safety constraints, Equipment constraints, Reliability constraints, Quality constraints are not violated, Economic Optimisation is fulfilled, and relevant KPIs are improved
  • Install and configure of APC/RTO software and systems
  • Integrate & Interface APC/RTO systems with DCS, secure access to stake holders working along with Instrument, IT and Site engineers
  • Assist in benefit analysis activity
  • Assist in APC/RTO benchmarking and Audit process
  • Mentor subordinates & team members and ensure knowledge continuity and transparency
  • Stay updated with changes in plant and control system, analyse and correct its impact on existing implementations.

HSE & Other Regulatory Compliance

  • Ensure compliance with HSE procedures
  • Ensure compliance with applicable local environmental site, statutory regulations applicable
  • Ensure compliance to internal APC/RTO Standard

title: Factory Scheduling Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About The Business

Tata Electronics Pvt. Ltd. is a prominent global player in the electronics manufacturing industry, with fast-emerging capabilities in Electronics Manufacturing Services, Semiconductor Assembly & Test, Semiconductor Foundry, and Design Services. Established in 2020 as a greenfield venture of the Tata Group, the company aims to serve global customers through integrated offerings across a trusted electronics and semiconductor value chain. With a rapidly growing workforce, the company currently employs over 65,000 people and has significant operations in Gujarat, Assam, Tamil Nadu, and Karnataka, India. Tata Electronics is committed to creating a socioeconomic footprint by employing many women in its workforce and actively supporting local communities through initiatives in environment, education, healthcare, sports and livelihood.

Role Overview

The Fab Scheduling Engineer will be responsible for optimizing semiconductor manufacturing operations through advanced scheduling solutions, digital twin modeling, and factory dashboard applications. This role requires strong expertise in fab process scheduling and hands-on experience with Inficon, IBM, or equivalent platforms. A deep understanding of manufacturing KPI matrices is essential to drive efficiency, throughput, and cycle time improvements in a 300mm silicon fab environment.

Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain fab scheduling solutions
  • Enhance factory dashboard applications for real-time KPI monitoring.
  • Collaborate with teams to improve throughput, cycle time, planning bottle neck mitigation strategy and WIP management.
  • Analyze manufacturing KPIs (OEE, utilization, yield, cycle time) to drive improvements.
  • Provide technical support for fab automation and scheduling systems

Essential Attributes

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • KPI-driven decision-making mindset
  • Clear communicator and team collaborator
  • Detail-oriented, efficiency-focused, adaptable

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Industrial Engineering, or related field.
  • Hands-on expertise with commercial scheduling solutions such as Inficon Scheduler, IBM tools, or equivalent platforms
  • Solid understanding of manufacturing KPIs (throughput, cycle time, WIP, OEE).
  • Familiarity with 300mm silicon fab operations and automation systems.

Desired Experience Level

  • 3–5 years of experience in semiconductor manufacturing scheduling, with additional experience considered a strong advantage

descriptionHtml:
Description

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns and operates global data center facilities that require skilled maintenance engineers to ensure continuous operations. We're expanding our team to include Mechanical Service Engineers who will be responsible for critical infrastructure maintenance and operations. This position will serve as the primary technical resource for mechanical and HVAC systems maintenance within AWS data centers in India. The role requires hands-on management of mechanical infrastructure, including preventive maintenance, troubleshooting, and emergency response. The position will require 24x7 on-call support and rotational shifts (need basis general shift).

Key job responsibilities

Operations And Maintenance

  • Ownership of all Data Center changes/events/incidents/problems from beginning to end as well as overseeing the completion of post-mortems, root cause analysis and follow-up resolution actions.
  • Responsible for ensuring maintenance/ repairs of site-critical facility infrastructure or a Data Center are planned and executed to the best interest of the business.
  • Responsible for Asset and Inventory management.
  • Develop and maintain method statements, standard operating procedures, emergency response procedures, preventive maintenance programs, and all technical documentation.
  • Ensure standardization and consistency with best-in-class operating practices. (Technical Writing Skills and Automation)
  • Communicate operating philosophies, technical information, objectives and expectations to Amazon personnel and to the vendor critical facilities management teams.
  • Providing hands on facility support where required

Incident And Emergency Response

  • Reviewing incident reports, documenting periodic trend summaries, and providing updates and recommended actions to management.
  • Managing information flow during incidents while providing regular updates to management.
  • Manage and coordinate with vendors to resolve any incidents during emergency situations. This may require to physically be dispatched on to site to investigate and resolve the issue.
  • Ensure 24*7 shift operations in safe, secure manner without availability impact.

A day in the life

  • Troubleshoot facility and rack-level events within internal Service Level Agreements (SLA).
  • Perform rack installs, rack decommissioning, and facility MEP management.
  • Provide operational readings and key performance indicators
  • Responsible for the on-site management of contractors, sub-contractors and vendors, ensuring that all work performed is in accordance with established practices, procedures & local legislation.
  • Performance and oversight of maintenance and operations on all electrical, mechanical, and fire/life safety equipment within the data center.
  • Work schedule changes depending on specific site needs. Shifts can be up to 12-hours and may rotate on a predefined schedule.

About AWS

Diverse Experiences

Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Work/Life Balance

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

Inclusive Team Culture

AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship and Career Growth

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

  • Bachelor's degree
  • 2+ years of electrical or mechanical experience

Preferred Qualifications

  • 2+ years of data center engineering experience
  • Bachelor's degree in engineering, project management, construction management or similar technical focus
  • Knowledge of BMS and EPMS control systems and data collection/trending

title: Downstream Corrossion Engineer (Relocation to Saudi Arabia is required)
descriptionHtml:
This position requires full relocation to Saudi Arabia. It is a permanent full time Expat position with an attractive relocation package.


Please note only qualified candidates will be contacted.


Overview:


We are seeking an experienced Corrosion Engineer to join our Global Manufacturing Excellence (GME) organization under the Downstream Reliability Solutions Department (RSD).

the Reliability Solutions Department (RSD) provides engineering support to Saudi Aramco Global Manufacturing wholly owned and affiliates’ facilities (Refining, NGL Processing, and Petrochemicals). This includes reliability, inspection, corrosion management, static equipment, rotating equipment, electrical equipment, instrumentation and control support.

Your primary role as a Corrosion Engineer is to provide technical support to operating facilities, and the deployment of new technologies related to corrosion management. Developing and prioritizing value-adding programs aimed at enhancing the operational performance of the Saudi Aramco’s downstream assets. You will also conduct technical studies and analyses in specialized corrosion control fields, including cathodic protection, water treatment, chemical inhibition and materials selection.


Key Responsibilities:


As the successful candidate you will be required to perform the following:

  • Conduct corrosion management assessments & studies, identifying corrosion issues and providing recommendations to mitigate them.
  • Develop, and manage the GME Strategic value-driven programs roadmap.
  • Deploy technologies related to corrosion management across the Global Manufacturing portfolio.
  • Supports corrosion related failure investigations and publish lessons learned from RCAs to avoid reoccurrence.
  • Provide consultancy to Global Manufacturing facilities during design, construction, operations and maintenance on matters pertaining to corrosion management.
  • Review operations parameters to identify any required modifications to the operating philosophy and procedures to properly manage corrosion issues.
  • Conduct corrosion mitigation and integrity review to optimize inspection and corrosion programs and maintain assets overall integrity.
  • Review design packages and validate materials selection based on applicable codes and standards.
  • Support conduction of risk-based inspection studies (RBIs) based on API-580 methodology.
  • Investigate coating related failures and recommended sound, cost effective solutions.
  • Support HAZOP review studies from corrosion management point of view.


Minimum Requirements:


As a successful candidate you will hold a:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical or Metallurgical Engineering. An advanced degree is preferable.
  • 15 years of experience in corrosion management, metallurgical sciences, and welding engineering in the Oil and Gas Industry’s “downstream sector”.
  • Able to demonstrate knowledge of the various international standards and codes including NACE, ASME, API and ASTM with emphasis on corrosion and inspection codes such as API-571, API-580, API-570 and API-510.
  • NACE Specialist certification, NACE Senior Corrosion Technologist certification or combination of NACE Corrosion Technologist, API-571 and NACE CP level II is preferable.
  • Able to demonstrate fluency in English, oral and written.

descriptionHtml:

  • Perform baseline NVH CAE analysis for BIW and body structures and present concise technical insights to stakeholders.
  • Develop and optimize body structures to meet NVH targets such as:
  • Global static & dynamic stiffness
  • Local dynamic stiffness
  • Frequency response (VTF, NTF)
  • Support design teams in delivering NVH-compliant solutions within program timelines.
  • Drive test support activities and ensure effective test-to-CAE correlation.
  • Consider real-world constraints (packaging, manufacturing, cost) during solution development.
  • Participate in model build, debugging, and validation of simulation setups.
  • Work collaboratively in cross-functional teams in a fast-paced development environment.


Job Requirements:

  • Primary Skills Required
  • Strong expertise in BIW/component NVH performance development using CAE.
  • Hands-on experience with:
  • Optistruct – Static, Modal, Dynamic (FRF, NTF, VTF), Optimization
  • Debugging and model validation
  • Ability to interpret CAE results and provide actionable design recommendations.
  • Good understanding of low-frequency NVH behaviour (0–500 Hz).
  • Proficiency in HyperWorks suite (HyperMesh, HyperView, HyperGraph).
  • Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving capability.
  • Good communication and presentation skills.


Additional Skills Preferred

  • Experience in design optimization techniques.
  • Exposure to Excel macro/VBA automation.
  • Knowledge of:
  • BIW structure design & development
  • Virtual series development process
  • Connections, joints, and kinematics modelling
  • Awareness of manufacturing feasibility and packaging constraints.
  • Familiarity with acoustic cavity modelling.


Experience Required

  • 6–10 years of experience in automotive NVH CAE analysis.
  • Proven experience in:

  • Design improvement recommendations based on CAE results
  • Capability to independently handle medium-to-high complexity tasks.
  • Experience in OEM/Tier-1 environments preferred.

  • Primary: Optistruct (SOL101, 103, 108, 111, 200 equivalent)

  • Others: MS Office (Excel, PowerPoint, Word)
  • Exposure to CAD/PLM tools (3DEXPERIENCE preferred)


Experience Preferred

  • Experience with physical testing methods for body structures
  • Exposure to OEM CAE workflows and quality processes
  • Understanding of IT/PLM systems


Key Competencies

  • Technical depth in NVH CAE (low-frequency focus)
  • Structured problem-solving approach
  • Cross-functional collaboration
  • Delivery ownership under timelines

The role requires hands-on management of mechanical infrastructure, including preventive maintenance, troubleshooting, and emergency response. Operations And Maintenance

  • Ownership of all Data Center changes/events/incidents/problems from beginning to end as well as overseeing the completion of post-mortems, root cause analysis and follow-up resolution actions.

  • Develop and maintain method statements, standard operating procedures, emergency response procedures, preventive maintenance programs, and all technical documentation.

Incident And Emergency Response

  • Reviewing incident reports, documenting periodic trend summaries, and providing updates and recommended actions to management.

  • Perform rack installs, rack decommissioning, and facility MEP management.

  • Responsible for the on-site management of contractors, sub-contractors and vendors, ensuring that all work performed is in accordance with established practices, procedures & local legislation.
  • Performance and oversight of maintenance and operations on all electrical, mechanical, and fire/life safety equipment within the data center.
  • Work schedule changes depending on specific site needs. Shifts can be up to 12-hours and may rotate on a predefined schedule.

title: Engineering Manage
descriptionHtml:
Syndigo powers the continual flow of data and content throughout the entire commerce ecosystem— accelerating delivery of accurate and compelling information that increases sales on every shelf. We are the recognized leader in software and services for the management of master data, product information, digital assets, and content syndication and analytics across industries including grocery, foodservice, hardlines, home improvement, oil & gas, pet, health and beauty, automotive, apparel, and healthcare products.

Syndigo serves the industry’s largest two-sided network, connecting more than 50,000 global users across 12,000+ global brands with more than 1,750 global retailers.

Basically, we're the people that deliver the rich, accurate product content that helps consumers shop online with confidence, and helps brands and retailers operate efficient product supply chains. We cannot do all of this without our amazing employees who make the magic happen here at Syndigo. As we continue to grow, we’re always looking to identify talented individuals to join our team.

 

**This is a hybrid position that requires 2 days per week in office at our Bangalore location**

 

Reporting directly to the Director of Engineering, the Engineering Manager will lead a high-performing engineering team responsible for building and scaling mission-critical systems. This role combines hands-on technical leadership with people management responsibilities, partnering closely with Product, Design, QA, DevOps, and Engineering leaders to deliver reliable, scalable, and high-quality software solutions. We are looking for a collaborative leader who can drive execution, mentor engineers, influence technical direction, and contribute to the broader engineering strategy while fostering a culture of ownership, innovation, and continuous improvement.

HOW WE’LL BE WINNING TOGETHER DAY TO DAY

• Lead, mentor, and grow a team of 8–12 software engineers across multiple experience levels
• Manage hiring, onboarding, performance management, career development, and retention initiatives
• Conduct regular 1:1 meetings, establish clear goals, and provide constructive feedback to support team growth
• Foster a culture of collaboration, accountability, technical excellence, and continuous improvement
• Drive end-to-end delivery of roadmap commitments with a focus on quality, reliability, and timely execution
• Partner with Product Management to prioritize roadmap initiatives while balancing feature delivery and technical investments
• Manage sprint planning, estimations, dependency management, and risk mitigation across teams
• Track and improve engineering metrics related to delivery, quality, operational health, and system reliability
• Define and guide the technical direction for the team’s services and platforms
• Promote engineering best practices including code quality, automated testing, CI/CD, observability, security, and operational excellence
• Participate in architecture discussions, design reviews, code reviews, and incident management activities
• Drive improvements in scalability, reliability, performance, and technical debt reduction
• Collaborate closely with Product, Design, QA, DevOps, and customer-facing teams to align on priorities and business outcomes
• Communicate effectively with stakeholders and senior leadership on progress, trade-offs, risks, and delivery expectations
• Contribute to organization-wide engineering initiatives, hiring efforts, and process improvements

WE SHOULD TALK IF THIS SOUNDS LIKE YOU

• 8+ years of professional software engineering experience, including 2+ years of direct people management experience
• Proven experience building, shipping, and operating large-scale distributed systems in production environments
• Strong technical expertise with technologies such as Java, .NET, Python, or Node.js along with microservices and REST APIs
• Hands-on experience working with SQL/NoSQL databases and cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP
• Experience with Agile/Scrum methodologies, DevOps practices, and CI/CD pipelines
• Strong communication, stakeholder management, and conflict resolution skills
• Demonstrated success in hiring, mentoring, and retaining engineering talent
• Experience driving engineering best practices across quality, scalability, reliability, and operational excellence
• Experience participating in architectural discussions and guiding technical decision-making
• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience
• Experience in SaaS, e-commerce, master data management (MDM), product information management (PIM), or data syndication domains (preferred but not required)
• Experience leading distributed teams across multiple geographies (preferred but not required)
• Familiarity with AI/ML-enabled product features (preferred but not required)

 

 

Diversity, Equity & Inclusion

To achieve the best version of our organization, we know it takes new ideas, new approaches, new perspectives and new ways of thinking. A purpose we are 100% committed to cultivating.

Diversity is woven into our fabric at Syndigo and it’s how we stay an industry leader, innovating technology solutions that equip our customers with everything they need to be successful! 

All are welcome here and we invite you to join our team if you are ready to help us continue that growth!

title: Seating Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Role Title- Design Engineer- Seating system

Sub domain - Seat structure, Mechanism, complete seat, Seating plastics

Tools- CATIA V5/V6, 3DExperiance, Teamcenter, Visualization Mock-up

Exp – 5 – 8 yrs

Education -Bachelors/Master’s degree in mechanical engineering, Automotive Engineering, or a related field

Job Descriptions:

• Responsible for designing of seating system commodities - Seat structure, Mechanism, complete seat, OB/IB valance, Head rest, seat mounting brackets etc

• Extensive experience in using CATIA V5 & V6 (Generative Shape design, Part Design, Kinematics, Assembly & Drawing workbench)

• Create parametric 3D proposals in Catia maintaining editable history, define materials & create components as well as assembly drawings with drawing standards wherever applicable.

• Packaging studies, environment check, kinematics simulation (if applicable) for various mechanisms with good knowledge of all regulatory and functional requirements.

• Very good understanding of DFM and DFA

• Detailed Engineering knowledge of design, function, performance, production & manufacturing requirements

• Ensure system, sub-system and components meets required interfaces, DVA, Optical and Perceived Quality targets.

• Ensure Regulatory compliance of system, sub-system and components.

• Follow and deliver company goals and strategies.

• Establishing and maintain the teamwork plan aligned to vehicle program.

• Basic Knowledge of rules and reactions in Catia

• Should have good GD& T knowledge

• Ensure data is up to date and reflects the required levels of maturity at any given point in time

• Provide CAD support, leading and progressing the design in line with the program timescales and deliverable cadence

• Be responsible for communication with all Stake holders e.g. Design team, studio, legal, packaging, legal etc

• Ensuring that the all project deliverables are met.

Skill Requirements:

• In depth knowledge of products, development process, Tools & technologies in the domain of seating system commodities product engineering & development.

• Familiar with new technology developments & regulations

• Very good working experience in CATIA V5/V6, 3DExperiance, Teamcenter Visualization Mock-up

• Excellent communication skills.

• PC Literacy: Microsoft Project, Power Point, Excel, Word etc.

• Customer Centricity and Driving Execution

• Agile or Scrum will be added advantage.

title: GRADE Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Scope of Role

The GRADE Lead Engineer is responsible for leadership of Electrical, Electronic and Electromechanical (EEE) product requirement validation


Area of Responsibility

This position is responsible for establishing and planning to achieve robust deployment of Electrical, Electronic and Electromechanical (EEE) products. You will have responsibility for:

  • The GRADE review, deep-dive design audit process.
  • Responsible for achieving robust deployment of Electrical, Electronic and Electromechanical (EEE) products.
  • Carry out robust design justification, analysis and verification to demonstrate the product is good by design.
  • Detect and fix design issues as early as possible, prior to design freeze, when it is relatively easier and less expensive to correct mistakes, utilizing expert auditors as guides.
  • Ensure issues / mistakes made in the past are not repeated, by adhering to the guidelines, PR-AIMs and things that have gone wrong in the past.
  • Ensure that supplier is properly sourced (ESOW) and on-boarded to correctly engage with the GRADE process with technical expertise, document sharing & project management.


Knowledge / Experience – 6 to 8 Years

Essential:

  • Proven project management capability demonstrated by recent delivery in line with time, Cost, quality & attribute targets
  • Proven experience in electrical, electronics, electromechanical commodity development and/or integration of at least one complete program.
  • Engineering knowledge of defined component(s) / system(s) design, function, performance, production & manufacturing requirements,
  • Excellent communications skills, demonstrated ability to communicate at all levels
  • Liaise with supplier, Manufacturing, Validation and cross functional teams.
  • PC Literacy: Microsoft Project, Power Point, Excel, Word etc
  • CAD Literacy: Ability to operate CAD software like CATIA V5/V6.
  • Significant experience in use of engineering tools FMEA, Six Sigma, problem resolution etc.
  • Successful history of delivery within the automotive sector.


Qualification:

  • BE/B. Tech in Electrical/Electronics/ Automotive Engineering

title: Engineer - Precast Execution
descriptionHtml:
The Engineer – Precast Execution is responsible for managing the safe, timely, and accurate installation of precast elements such as columns, beams, wall panels, staircases, and slabs at the project site. This role ensures that erection activities are carried out in compliance with design specifications, safety protocols, and quality standards through effective planning, coordination, and supervision.

Plan and supervise the erection and installation of precast concrete elements at site, ensuring sequence, alignment, jointing, and tolerance requirements are met as per approved drawings and method statements. ? Coordinate with precast production, transport, and logistics teams to ensure timely delivery of precast elements to the site and manage storage or staging areas for smooth handling. ? Conduct pre-erection checks to ensure foundation or substructure readiness, presence of embedded plates or sleeves, and availability of erection equipment such as cranes, lifters, and rigging tools. ? Supervise the lifting, placing, and fixing of precast components such as columns, beams, walls, facades, staircases, and slabs, ensuring stability, safety, and correct alignment during and after erection. ? Ensure proper application of grout, sealants, and connection systems (e.g., bolting, welding, dowels) as per design details, and monitor curing processes for connection joints.

Title

SME Granulation (Engineering)

Location:

Mumbai

Key Responsibilities

At Sun Pharma, we commit to helping you “Create your own sunshine”— by fostering an environment where you grow at every step, take charge of your journey and thrive in a supportive community.

Are You Ready to Create Your Own Sunshine?

As you enter the Sun Pharma world, you’ll find yourself becoming ‘Better every day’ through continuous progress. Exhibit self-drive as you ‘Take charge’ and lead with confidence. Additionally, demonstrate a collaborative spirit, knowing that we ‘Thrive together’ and support each other’s journeys.”

Job Description

 Job Summary

Provide technical leadership for granulation processes and equipment (wet, dry/roller compaction, and fluid-bed systems), ensuring robust, compliant, and efficient operations across development, scale-up, and commercial manufacturing & operations at all sites of SGO.

Area Of Responsibility

Technical Expertise

  • Act as the primary expert for high-shear mixers/RMG, fluid-bed granulators/dryers (FBD), roller compactors, milling and blending systems, bin handling, and closed transfer systems.
  • Define and optimize critical process parameters (CPPs) and material attributes (CMAs) for consistent granule quality (PSD, LOD, porosity, flowability—Carr Index / Hausner Ratio).

Troubleshooting & Support

  • Lead resolution of chronic issues: low yield, poor granule flow, inconsistent LOD, segregation, over/under granulation, capping/chipping in downstream compression.
  • Execute structured RCA (5-Why, Fishbone) and implement permanent corrective actions.
  • Should be able to handle troubleshooting and problem-solving, acting as the primary authority for resolving complex production issues, machine malfunctions, and deviations that arise during the granulation process.
  • Should have capability for installation and commissioning of granulation equipment.
  • Should have knowledge about instrumentation, calibration, and operation of components installed on granulation machines.

Process Optimization/Benchmarking

  • Drive OEE improvement, cycle time reduction, and SMED for batch changeovers.
  • Implement PAT tools (e.g., NIR moisture, torque/power trend analysis) and digital logging to stabilize batches.

Compliance & Validation

  • Ensure adherence to cGMP, cleaning validation, cross-contamination control, containment (OEB levels), ATEX/dust explosion safety.
  • Own equipment lifecycle: URS → FAT/SAT → IQ/OQ/PQ, change control, and periodic review; ensure 21 CFR Part 11 compliance for data integrity.

Training & Capability Building

  • Ability to Train operators/maintenance on best practices: endpoint detection, sieving/milling, cleaning/line clearance, and safety protocols.

Vendor/OEM Management/Emerging Technologies

  • Liaise with OEMs for upgrades, process audits, spares, retrofits (e.g., WIP/CIP, improved bowl designs, containment solutions).
  • Candidate should have a flair to remain update on latest Trends and technologies in the field

Physical Requirements: Physically fit for extensive Travel

Technical Knowledge

  • Granulation science: binder systems, torque/power curves, endpoint criteria, moisture profiles, PSD control, and downstream compressibility.
  • Equipment qualification and validation; data integrity; cleaning validation; containment and ATEX.
  • CI toolset: TPM, Lean, Six Sigma (Green/Black Belt preferred), SMED, Kaizen.
  • Digital & Analytics: Comfortable with OEE dashboards, trend analysis, PAT signals, and batch data review for CPV.
  • Soft Skills: Strong problem-solving, shop-floor presence, stakeholder influence, and vendor management.
  • Work experience with Equipment manufacturers will be an added advantage

Travel Estimate

Up to 40%-50% India and Globally

Job Requirements

 Educational Qualification

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree

Experience

12–15 years in pharma granulation (OSD), with hands-on exposure to wet granulation, fluid-bed drying, and roller compaction.

Your Success Matters to Us

At Sun Pharma, your success and well-being are our top priorities! We provide robust benefits and opportunities to foster personal and professional growth. Join us at Sun Pharma, where every day is an opportunity to grow, collaborate, and make a lasting impact. Let’s create a brighter future together!

The role ensures equipment readiness, adherence to maintenance schedules, compliance with safety standards, and optimal utilization of machinery to support uninterrupted project execution.

Key Responsibilities/ Accountabilities

  • Supervise the operation and maintenance of all construction equipment and machinery at the site, ensuring high availability and performance.
  • Implement preventive maintenance schedules and checklists, coordinating servicing activities with site teams and vendors.
  • Monitor fuel consumption, equipment utilization, and downtime; take corrective actions to minimize losses.
  • Ensure compliance with OEM guidelines, safety protocols, and statutory regulations during equipment handling and operations.
  • Support in the mobilization and demobilization of equipment at the site, maintaining proper documentation.

title: Engineer Intervention KG KKD
descriptionHtml:
Job Accountabilities

To support/assist Subsea Intervention with the objective of Safely execution to ensure that the Job is carried out as per Procedure. Co-ordinate with Logistic/Spares /Base workshop Engineer to make available all intervention tooling for any planned & Unplanned activities.

Job Accountabilities

  • Assist in preparation and development Intervention procedure and acquire knowledge to perform the task independently
  • Ensure correctness of VMIR issued with the Intervention procedure in-terms of torque values & interface requirement
  • Keep history of all Intervention activities along with time taken for the job completion
  • Adhere to Intervention SOP and ensure all Lesson Learned related to continuous improvement of SOP are closed and up-to date;
  • Participate in Design & Safety Reviews, HAZOP, HASIDs, Risk Assessments etc.;
  • Review to subsea trees and all ROV interfaces and systems available to carry out well intervention works and ensure fit for purpose interfaces
  • Maintains a log of operations events, lessons learned reports, and deviation request
  • Support ROV operated Valve movement & Trouble shooting in the field
  • Adherence to PTW/MOC system for carrying out Interventions
  • Review of Standard Operating procedures / Work Instructions for Intervention, Standard Operating procedures
  • Review SITs Procedure for ROV accessibility
  • Participate in FEED & Detail Engineering activities for upcoming Brown Field Projects from O&M group.
  • Participate in FEED/Engineering Study for all In-House project w.r.t new subsea equipment installation related to Subsea System modification/ repair/ operation/ inspection
  • Participate in HAZID/HAZOP/RA for all Intervention & Hardware Activities and implementation of mitigating measures /emergency actions assigned
  • Support HSE with all required inputs from Intervention group such as RA / HAZID / HAZOP / Safety Observations / Meetings etc
  • Support intervention activities for handing over and taking over the subsea assets to & from Drilling & Completion / Projects in safe manner
  • Interface with all disciplines to obtain relevant data that may require Intervention inputs

Skill & Competencies

  • Key technical / functional competencies and skills required # Familiar with Subsea Intervention and Installation.
  • Familiar with International codes & standards, Lifting Analysis, Sea fastening, installation, Operations, Subsea Production System
  • Familiar with FAT, SIT, and SAT.
  • Familiar with Subsea Production System Installation & Design.
  • Knowledge of HAZOP / HAZID / RA and Risk Mgmt.
  • Should have good Communication, Teaming & Analytical skills and understanding of Planning & Organization; Interpersonal relations; Technical Report writing

Education Required

Bachelor/Master#s Degree in engineering

Experience Required

3 to 5 years# experience in Oil & Gas out of which 2 years in Subsea/Deepwater Maintenance activities

title: PRIMARY ENGINEER
descriptionHtml:
Objective / Purpose As a Design Engineer (Primary), the person shall be capable of preparing, reviewing & executing Primary Engineering Activities for Substation Projects as per the direction of Design Lead (Primary). He must have good knowledge in Layout Engineering in Substation Projects. He shall facilitate the modellers in development of BIM 3D Model for Substations.

As a Design Engineer (Primary), the person shall be required to design the layout of the substation and provide inputs to the draftsman for development of drawings.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Timely review of the drawings developed by the draftsman
  • Interact with Site Execution & Cluster teams for clarification w.r.t. the design of equipment
  • Coordinate with inter-disciplinary areas, inter-departmental checks (Civil & Structural, MEP & Instrumentation) for obtaining concurrence in design specifications
  • Ensure compliance to specification requirements
  • Review of drawings (2D & 3D) and Documentation conforming to Quality systems
  • Review of Vendor Offers and Documents
  • Pre-Tender Engineering including estimation of BOM (Bill of Materials) and Offer Reviews
  • Prepare design calculations of all Substation equipment (sizing calculations of Busbar, UPS, DG, LT Transformer, Earthing Conductor) & other calculations (viz. Short circuit force, Sag tension etc.)
  • Reviewing of Bill of Material and comparing with the Tender Quantity

Technical Expertise: The Design Engineer (Primary) is required to have complete understanding of Primary Engineering activities like SLD Preparation, Layout Engineering, Earthing, Cable Routing, Lighting, Lightning Protection, Cable Tray Routing etc. He should be capable of performing design & sizing calculations of Busbar, UPS, DG, LT Transformer, Earthing Conductor, calculations (Short circuit force, Sag tension etc.). The Engineer is required to have knowledge on National and International Codes and Standards. In addition, the Design Engineer (Primary) should also have an overall understanding of the inter-disciplinary (Civil & Structural, Mechanical and Instrumentation) design aspects of electrical equipment.

descriptionHtml:

  • Responsible for the Operation & Maintenance of equipment fleet.

  • Knowledge of PT systems and stressing procedures
  • Familiarity with hydraulic and stressing equipment
  • Basic understanding of construction safety practices
  • Ability to work in coordination with cross-functional teams

Role Expectation

  • Responsible for end-to-end execution of launching gantry activities at site
  • Ensure safe, efficient, and timely completion of all segmental works
